data.title: 空门苍 · 御神木下的深宵秘事
data.description: 满月洒在幽暗的后山御神木下。巫女服的白色襦袢散乱开来，苍双手攀着粗壮的树干，绯袴被完全褪至膝头，在夏夜清凉的山风中发出了甜腻的娇喘。
data.location: secluded clearing beneath gigantic ancient sacred cedar tied with shimenawa ropes
data.action: pressed against mossy cedar trunk with miko robe disheveled and scarlet hakama pulled down, arching back in wild breathless bliss under silver moonlight
data.lighting: luminous full moon casting dramatic silver beams and deep forest shadows
data.mood: sacred mystical ecstasy, wild nighttime abandon, breathless heart-pounding passion
data.promptProse: Clinging to the ancient sacred tree at midnight, miko Ao pants with open mouth as silver moonlight illuminates her exposed hips and disheveled robes.
data.animaCaption: Ao pressed against the sacred tree in disheveled miko robes under the silver moon.
